title: Transformer PET/CT fusion predicts spread through air spaces in lung adenocarcinoma
summary: In a multicenter retrospective study of 212 patients (219 tumors) from three institutions, a transformer-based framework fused eight 2.5D PET and CT representations to assess preoperative STAS risk. It reached an AUC of 0.822 (95% CI 0.725-0.920) in the independent external test cohort, above the single-modality and conventional fusion models compared. The model risk score was associated with progression-free survival (HR 4.24, 95% CI 1.47-12.25), although few progression events call for caution.
ai_technology: Transformer-based multimodal framework fusing 2.5D PET and CT representations

evidence.tested: Independent external test cohort within a retrospective three-center study.
evidence.unknown: Small cohort, few progression events; prospective evaluation not done; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Model classifies STAS risk from imaging.
